QuestInfo.name: [Mechanical Hearts] Wondroid Savior
QuestInfo.0: You succeed taking down #bAspire#k and rescuing all the #bWondroids#k.\r\nBefore you leave, Spencer and Phoebe want to speak with you.
QuestInfo.2: #bSpencer#k and #bPhoebe#k thanked you for rescuing all the #bWondroids#k from #bAspire#k.\r\nAs they make new plans, you look to the future with hope.
